seed: Objects of type `wall` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [player,reflection,target] show mixed outcomes: no_change x2, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the presence, type or relative position of a neighbouring object. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks: axis band (10) on one block row, targets 11, pieces 5 rings, reflections 4 at row 2A-r (skip piece-occupied).
A1/A2 move the selection (axis or piece) one block row; A3/A4 move a selected piece one column (no-op when the axis is selected); pieces blocked by board edge / other pieces, never by the axis.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis; selection read from 0 centres grown through non-9 centres.
HUD col 63: n effective actions -> n cells 12 from top (past 64: top n-64 cells 5). Stateless.
Hypothesis 'wall A4 mixed no_change/gone' = object re-extraction when a piece's reflection crosses the axis, not a physics rule; n>=128 HUD unconfirmed.
